help.aid.moons.desc: At the end of the round, the player with the most visible moons scores 2 bonus points. In case of a tie, nobody scores the bonus.

help.wolf.no-effect: No special effect. Its value counts toward the row battle.
help.wolf.moon-explain: At the end of the round, the player with the most visible moons scores 2 bonus points. In case of a tie, nobody scores the bonus.
help.wolf.corner-triple: If this card is in one of the 4 corners of the panorama at the end of the round, its value counts triple (= {tripled}) for the row battle.
help.wolf.corner-triple.cover: It must still be covered by a value {coverValue}, even in a corner.
help.wolf.bonus-point: If you win a row containing this card, it scores 2 points instead of 1 (1 normal + 1 bonus).
help.wolf.bonus-point.copies: Each player has 2 copies of this card.

help.wolf.lone.explain: Chosen by the round winner and added to their deck. Strengthens the pack for the next rounds.
help.wolf.rules.title: Placement rules
help.wolf.rules.grid: Cards are placed on a grid that grows up to a 4×3 or 3×4 rectangle.
help.wolf.rules.cover: You can cover an opponent's wolf by placing a card with exactly +1 value on top. The covered card is hidden and no longer counts.
help.wolf.rules.row: Each row is a battle: the player with the highest total value wins the row and recovers their visible cards.
help.wolf.rules.scoring: Each recovered card = 1 point. Value 3 cards with the +1 icon = 2 points.
help.alpha.cardtext.1: When covering an opponent's wolf you can jump one value
help.alpha.cardtext.3: Your opponent can't cover any of your 1 value Wolves
help.alpha.cardtext.5: Cover any of your opponent's Wolf with one having the same value
help.alpha.cardtext.6: A bonus of 2 Moons when counting Moon's majority
help.alpha.cardtext.7: Win all ties when facing one (Moons, sum of values, round points, etc.)
help.alpha.cardtext.8: Move a pile of cards in an empty space before placing a 2 Valued Wolf
help.alpha.desc.1: When covering an opponent's wolf, you may skip a value: place value +2 instead of +1.
help.alpha.example.1: Example: cover a value 2 wolf with your value 4.
help.alpha.desc.2: You start each round with 5 cards in hand instead of 3. More cards = more choices each turn.
help.alpha.desc.3: Your opponent cannot cover your value 1 wolves. Your positions with value 1 (and their moons or corner ×3 effect) are safe.
help.alpha.desc.4: Place 2 cards in a single turn. After your first placement, you may place a second card or pass.
help.alpha.desc.5: Cover an opponent's wolf with a wolf of the same value (instead of value +1 normally).
help.alpha.example.5: Example: cover a value 3 wolf with your value 3.
help.alpha.desc.6: You gain 2 extra moons when counting moon majority. These are added to the moons visible on your panorama cards.
help.alpha.desc.7: You win all ties: tied moons = you have majority. Tied row values = you win the row. Tied round score = you win the round.
help.alpha.desc.8: Move a card pile to an adjacent empty space, then place a value 2 wolf. Both the move and the placement must follow normal placement rules.
help.alpha.ambush-note: The card is flipped after use. It becomes available again next round.
help.alpha.moon-reminder: Reminder: the player with the most visible moons scores 2 bonus points. In case of a tie, nobody scores.
help.mountain.title: Mountain Token
help.mountain.desc: The round winner receives a piece of their mountain. The first player to get 2 pieces completes their mountain and wins the game.
help.mountain.round.1: Players take turns placing wolves on the panorama (4×3 or 3×4 rectangle).
help.mountain.round.2: A wolf can be placed adjacent to an existing card, or on top of an opponent's wolf with exactly +1 value.
help.mountain.round.3: The round ends when the rectangle is complete or a player places their last card.
help.mountain.scoring.1: Moon majority → 2 bonus points (no bonus if tied)
help.mountain.scoring.2: Each row is a battle: highest total value wins (tie → both lose the row)
help.mountain.scoring.3: The row winner recovers their visible cards: each card = 1 point, value 3 cards = 2 points
help.mountain.between: Between rounds: the winner chooses a Lone Wolf (added to their deck). The loser chooses an Alpha Power (kept for the rest of the game).

tuto.lore-intro: The last lone wolf, guardian of the mountain, has vanished. Rival packs now clash to seize this promising territory. As the Alpha, you must do whatever it takes to ensure your pack's survival. Strategically place your wolves to claim the mountain!
tuto.hand: This is your hand. Each card is a wolf with a value (1 to 5). You'll use them to claim territory on the battlefield.
tuto.place-first: Place your value 1 wolf on the battlefield.
tuto.panorama: Your opponent played next to your wolf. Together, the cards form the panorama — a rectangular territory that grows up to 4×3 or 3×4. Each row will be a battle at the end of the round.
tuto.effects: Some cards have special icons. For example, these 2 cards on the battlefield triple their value if they are in a corner of the panorama at the end of the round. You can always click on a card to find this information later.
tuto.bonus-point: At the end of the round, each of your cards in a row you won scores one point. This wolf of value 3 scores one extra point if you win its row (2 points total).
tuto.place-second: Now place your value 3 wolf adjacent to an existing card.
tuto.stacking-explain: You can cover an opponent's wolf by placing a card with exactly +1 value on top! The covered wolf no longer counts. However, you cannot cover the opponent's last visible wolf.
tuto.stacking-do: Place your value 2 wolf on the opponent's value 1 wolf to take control of that spot.
tuto.scoring: When the panorama is complete (12 cards are visible, forming a 4×3 or 3×4 rectangle), the round is over. The round can also end if a player plays their last card (if it's the first player, the second player gets one last turn).
tuto.scoring-moons: To determine the round winner, start by counting the number of visible moons in each player's panorama. The player with the most visible moons earns a 2-point bonus.
tuto.scoring-rows: Then, row by row, check which player has the most points in the row. That player collects their visible wolves from the row. Each visible wolf scores 1 point. Value 3 cards score 1 bonus point, as seen just before.
tuto.scoring-winner:
The player with the most points wins the round.
In case of a tie, the player who collected the most wolves wins.
tuto.win-and-beyond: The round winner earns a mountain token . First to collect 2 wins! Between rounds, the winner picks a Lone Wolf to strengthen their pack, and the loser gains an Alpha Power — a special ability for future rounds.
tuto.good-luck:
You're ready! Lead your pack under the moonlight and claim the mountain.
Good luck!
help.alpha.how-to-get: How to get: The loser of each round chooses one of the two revealed Alpha Power cards.
